thread:
Alex: Quick status check — release run 3.7 is mostly green but we have one cherry-pick failing QA for feat/fast-alloc.
Maria: Which test is failing? CI shows a flake in `integration/linux-mem`.
Alex: mem-pressure scenario — reproduces locally with `./test/integration --mem 1G`.
Devon: I can take this. preliminary look suggests the allocator tweak from #542 regressed eviction timing. I'll prepare a backport cherry-pick.
Cheng: Heads up: canary is scheduled for 18:00 UTC. If the cherry-pick isn't in, do we want to hold or proceed without it? :thinking:
Sara: From docs/product side: we can proceed if there's a graceful fallback, but we need eng-sre signoff for the config toggle.
release-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-03-17T18:00:00Z — rollout: canary -> 10% -> 100%.
Maria: pinging @lee for fallback flag readiness.
lee (eng-sre): I can enable runtime.fallback_raft=true as a soft safety net, but the PR must include a healthcheck hook so we can auto-abort on regressions.
Devon: Adding the healthcheck to the PR now, will push in ~20m and mention @lee. Will also include a tiny test to exercise eviction under mem-pressure.
Alex: Plan: Devon merges cherry-fix + healthcheck before 17:30 UTC. If CI is green we go ahead with 18:00 canary. If not, abort and reschedule.
Sara: Small docs note — feature flag and fallback behavior need a short blurb for release notes. I can draft if someone posts the toggle name.
Maria: I'll keep an eye on latency and token-cost dashboards during canary. Please call out any anomaly in #incidents immediately.
Alex: Quick ask: reviewers, please leave an LGTM or :thumbsup: on Devon's PR so we can track approvals.
Devon: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/546 — tests running, comment when you review.
Cheng: Running full suite locally now, ETA ~12m. If any flakes show up I'll push a test-only fix branch.
lee (eng-sre): I'll stand by for the healthcheck and can enable the fallback flag quickly if needed. Also will prep runbook section for this canary.
Maria: Noted — I'll post a short checklist once canary starts: metrics, errors, latency, token-cost.
Alex: Thanks team. I'll update here when the PR is merged and again at canary start. :rocket:
